entries.rationale: Spec states the convention verbatim (BEH-1, AC1) and the plan supplies both the exact prose and the exact test; two files, markdown-only, autonomous per constitution.
BEH-2 through BEH-5 and BEH-7 plus the Error Cases table fully specify the revision obligations; the task appends supplied prose to the block Task 1 created and extends the same suite.
Integration Points table names the two non-delegating sites and AC4 fixes the outcome; both bullet rewrites are supplied verbatim and touch one SKILL.md plus the shared suite.

AC5/AC6 and the Template survey pin exactly three templates; tests/templates/spec-template.behavioral.test.mjs is a direct assertion exemplar. Four files, source confined to templates/; the software template needs an addition rather than a conversion.
Test-only task; AC6/AC7 and the Template survey define the discovery sweep and its deliberate exclusions, and tests/skills-no-inline-node.test.mjs is the in-repo sweep precedent. Single file.
